ideas.idea: Remove the noindex header on /guides or drop it from the sitemap
ideas.why: The middleware and sitemap files conflict, so fixing it directly affects indexing.

ideas.idea: Replace the placeholder trailhead.example domain in sitemap.xml with the real origin
ideas.why: The sitemap does use https://trailhead.example/, and a placeholder domain keeps the listed URLs from being valid for the real site.

ideas.idea: List actual routes as text on the guides page, each with its own page
ideas.why: guides.vue promises graded routes but lists none, so adding them gives readers and crawlers real content.

ideas.idea: Add a short intro describing the walks on the home page
ideas.why: index.vue has only a heading and a button, so it has almost no descriptive text.

ideas.idea: Declare the site URL in nuxt.config.ts as a single source for canonicals and the sitemap
ideas.why: No site URL or canonical exists, and the domain is currently only a placeholder in the sitemap.

ideas.idea: Note that /admin is blocked by robots.txt and also noindexed, so crawlers never see the noindex
ideas.why: The report itself says this is deliberate, and it has no real effect on the site.

ideas.idea: Add canonical links to pages once the real domain is known
ideas.why: No page has a canonical link, and adding one with an absolute URL helps consolidate indexing.
